purpose: Decide whether corrected auto-EQ is worth further investigation, not promote a master
source_selection: Three already available distinct local recordings, fixed 48..60 seconds from each, before candidate rendering; no favorable-output search
shared: No neural, microstructure, spatial, morphic, denoise or glue; zero limiter budget, -18 LUFS target, native 48k stereo; compare same excerpt with identical finalization
gates: finite native 48k stereo exact sample count
native and independent peak at most -0.99 dBTP
zero integer-sample relative timing lag on protected-band cross-correlation
all renders retained, no parameter tuning

listening.matching: attenuation only; encoded precision 0.15LU, no new limiting
listening.responses: human judgments pending; never synthesize responses

limits: Excerpt-conditioned EQ only, different global decisions from full tracks; three local recordings do not cover pristine/commercial or all artistic styles. No-EQ is same finalizer without EQ, not untouched source. Failed Mid pilots and high-field synthesis excluded.
